body:

decisions.note: Checked against existing dashboard run/monitor/execution-view items (searched title/body for 'run view','monitor','execution','concurrent'): closest are BI-0005 (pipeline monitoring/logging), BI-0027 (E2E workflow views) and BI-0015 (surface-all umbrella). None covers concurrent/parallel agent execution + a speedup indicator, so BI-0085 is NOT a duplicate/subsumed - left open. Distinct concern: concurrency/speedup observability in the run view.
